globalFlags.description: Seconds to wait for a connection, 0 for no limit (env: NORCUBE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT)

globalFlags.name: cli-read-timeout
globalFlags.description: Seconds to wait for each API response, 0 for no limit (env: NORCUBE_READ_TIMEOUT)

globalFlags.name: debug
globalFlags.description: Print every HTTP request and response to stderr, with credentials redacted (env: NORCUBE_DEBUG=1)

globalFlags.name: endpoint-url
globalFlags.description: Override a service endpoint, service=url (repeatable; services: auth, web_app, snapdb, langsync, domainradar, billing, monitor, prompthub)

globalFlags.name: max-attempts
globalFlags.description: Attempts for a request that hit throttling or a transient failure, 1 disables retries (env: NORCUBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)

globalFlags.name: no-color
globalFlags.description: Disable color and styling (env: NO_COLOR, CLICOLOR=0)

globalFlags.name: no-pager
globalFlags.description: Disable automatic paging of long table output (env: $PAGER controls the pager, default: less)

globalFlags.name: org
globalFlags.description: Run this command against a specific organization, id or slug (env: NORCUBE_ORG)

globalFlags.name: output
globalFlags.description: Output format: table | json | yaml | text | id (env: NORCUBE_OUTPUT)

globalFlags.name: profile
globalFlags.description: Use a named profile from the config file (env: NORCUBE_PROFILE)

globalFlags.name: query
globalFlags.description: JMESPath expression applied to the result before it is printed, e.g. "[?status=='failed'].jobId"

commands.name: billing
commands.short: See the organization's billing: status, subscriptions, usage, invoices, spending caps
commands.long:
Read the active organization's billing: whether the account is in good
standing, its subscriptions, this month's usage estimate and invoices, and
set its monthly spending caps.

Plans and payment methods are managed in the dashboard. A CI token with
billing.read can run every read command here; changing the spending caps
needs a person signed in with billing permissions.

commands.name: budget
commands.short: Show and set the organization's monthly spending caps
commands.long:
The budget caps what the organization spends in a billing month, in US
dollars. When the month's charges reach the hard cap, the account is
blocked and paid usage is refused (`norcube billing status` shows it); a
soft cap only warns. Alert thresholds are percentages of the hard cap (of
the soft cap when there is no hard cap) at which the organization's
invoicing email address gets a warning.

commands.name: get
commands.short: Show the monthly spending caps and alert thresholds
commands.example:
norcube billing budget get
norcube billing budget get -o json --query hardCapCents

commands.name: set
commands.short: Set the monthly spending caps or alert thresholds
commands.long:
Changes only what you pass; the other settings stay as they are.

  --hard-cap 500     stop paid usage at $500.00 a month ("none" removes it)
  --soft-cap 300     warn at $300.00 a month ("none" removes it)
  --alerts 50,80,100 email at these percentages of the cap

Reaching a hard cap blocks paid usage, so the command asks first; --yes
answers for scripts, and without a terminal --yes is required.
commands.example:
norcube billing budget set --hard-cap 500 --soft-cap 300
norcube billing budget set --alerts 50,90 --yes
norcube billing budget set --hard-cap none

flags.name: alerts
flags.description: Alert thresholds, percentages of the cap (50,80,100)

flags.name: hard-cap
flags.description: Monthly hard cap in US dollars ("none" removes it)

flags.name: soft-cap
flags.description: Monthly soft (warning) cap in US dollars ("none" removes it)

flags.name: yes
flags.description: Skip the confirmation prompt (required when stdin isn't a terminal)

commands.name: invoices
commands.short: List invoices and download them as PDF

commands.name: download
commands.long:
Saves the invoice as a PDF file, invoice-<id>.pdf in the current
directory unless --file names another (- writes it to standard output).
An existing file is never overwritten.
commands.example:
norcube billing invoices download 1042
norcube billing invoices download 1042 --file ~/Documents/norcube-2026-10.pdf

flags.name: file
flags.description: File to write (- for standard output; default invoice-<id>.pdf)

commands.name: list
commands.long:
Lists the organization's invoices with their billing period, status and
total. Download one with `norcube billing invoices download <id>`.
commands.example:
norcube billing invoices list
norcube billing invoices list -o json --query "[].{id: id, total: total, currency: currency}"

commands.name: status
commands.short: Show whether the organization's account is in good standing
commands.long:
Shows the account's status: active, grace (a payment failed; the grace
period runs until the date shown) or blocked (paid usage and new
resources are refused: an unpaid balance, or the month's charges reached
the hard spending cap).
commands.example:
norcube billing status
norcube billing status -o json --query status

commands.name: list
commands.short: List each service's billing and the plan the organization is on
commands.example:
norcube billing subscriptions list
norcube billing subscriptions list -o json --query "[?subscription].{service: code, plan: subscription.planCode}"

commands.name: usage
commands.short: See this month's usage and what it will cost

commands.name: estimate
commands.short: Show this month's charges so far and the estimate for the whole month
commands.long:
Shows what the organization's usage costs so far this billing month and
the estimated total, in US dollars. The estimate weighs the month's pace
against previous months; "linear" is the pace alone.
commands.example:
norcube billing usage estimate
norcube billing usage estimate -o json --query estimatedTotal

commands.name: metrics
commands.short: Show usage per metric against its free tier
commands.long:
Lists every billable metric with its free tier, the usage so far this
month and the projection for the month's end. OVER marks metrics on
track to exceed the free tier, which is where charges start.
commands.example:
norcube billing usage metrics
norcube billing usage metrics -o json --query "[?overflowProjected].metricCode"
